ProductApprovalOutput.description: The approval record, as echoed by compile/status output.

snapshot_path.description: Project-root-relative path of the immutable snapshot file.

ProductListEntry.description:
One product's row in `rocky product list`.

A projection of [`ProductStatusOutput`], built by the same function `product status` uses, so the two can never disagree. Missing values are `null`, never invented.

approval.description: The approval record, when one exists.

artifact_problems.description: Number of committed artifacts whose bytes no longer match the manifest. `0` is clean.

committed_phase.description: The committed lowering phase, when a manifest exists.

fulfill_state.description: The persisted fulfillment state tag, when one exists.

journal_rows.description: Number of fulfillment journal rows recorded for this product.

name.description: Product name: the spec file's stem, or the state store's key.

output_model.description: The resolved output model, when the spec parses.

spec_digest.description: The working spec's digest, when it parses.

spec_error.description: Why the spec failed to load — absent or unparseable — when it did.

spec_matches_approval.description: Whether the working spec equals the approved revision. `null` when either side is missing.

staging_journal_present.description: Whether an uncommitted staging journal is pending.

description:
JSON output of `rocky product list`.

One row per product the project knows, sorted by name. A project with no `products/` directory and no records lists nothing; that is not an error.

count.description: `products.len()`, repeated so a consumer can assert it received the whole list.

title: ProductListOutput
